name: AnythingLLM
description: All-in-one AI application for chatting with documents, using AI agents, and managing multiple LLM providers.

env.label: JWT Secret
env.description: Secret key for JWT token signing (auto-generated if not set)

env.label: Signature Key
env.description: Signing key for persisted secrets (auto-generated; at least 32 chars)

env.label: Signature Salt
env.description: Signing salt for persisted secrets (auto-generated; at least 32 chars)

env.label: Auth Token
env.description: Token for API authentication; leave empty to configure via Web UI on first launch

env.label: LLM Provider
env.description: LLM provider to use; can also be configured via the Web UI

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: OpenAI API key (required if using OpenAI as LLM provider); can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: Anthropic API key (required if using Anthropic as LLM provider); can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Google Gemini API Key
env.description: Google Gemini API key; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Groq API Key
env.description: Groq API key; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Mistral API Key
env.description: Mistral API key; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: OpenRouter API Key
env.description: OpenRouter API key; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Hugging Face API Token
env.description: Hugging Face access token; can also be configured in the Web UI
